question: A proton moves with a speed of $v = 3 \times 10^5$ m/s through a region of crossed fields. The electric field is $E = 6 \times 10^4$ V/m (downwards) and the magnetic field is $B = 0.4$ T (into the page). Calculate the net instantaneous force acting on the proton.
